title: Stalk localization of one factor of an etale root product chart
statement: Let n:N\to L be a morphism of schemes, R a commutative ring, phi:Spec R\to L etale, x in N and y in Spec R with phi(y)=n(x). Let f belong to the prime y, and let e_k be positive integers for k in Fin m. Suppose an isomorphism alpha over Spec R identifies N times_L Spec R with the spectrum of the product of R[T]/(T^(e_k)-f) [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product]. Set B=O_(N,x) and J=m_(L,n(x))B. There exist k in Fin m, a local commutative ring R0, f0 in its maximal ideal, a maximal prime P of D=R0[T]/(T^(e_k)-f0), and a flat local homomorphism beta:B\to D_P with J D_P=m_R0 D_P. Both quotients are the concrete AdjoinRoot quotients. No section, DVR or generic cover is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tag 0EYH: etale local root product description; Tag 0EYI: pointed etale neighborhood

proof.text: Use Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback on x and y to choose z above both. The given membership f in y is therefore membership at the second projection of z.

Apply the root product chart stalk presentation theorem to the second projection and z. It gives k, the canonical base stalk R0, f0, the maximal prime P and a compatible ring isomorphism theta from the pullback stalk to D_P.

Define beta by composing the stalk map of the first projection with theta. The first projection is etale by base change of phi, hence its stalk map is flat and local. A ring isomorphism is flat and local, so beta has both properties. This uses Flat.stalkMap and RingHom.Flat.of_bijective, with an explicit proof of locality.

Map the base maximal ideal through the equal scheme composites pullback.fst followed by n and pullback.snd followed by phi. The private maximalIdeal_stalkMap_comp helper expresses these as iterated ideal maps. The proved source-library FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal_stalkMap applies to phi and identifies its image with the maximal ideal of R0. Mapping the resulting equality through theta and using its structural compatibility proves the required identity in D_P. All ideal-map rewrites are written in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI: the chart localization argument; product presentation plus Mathlib pullback, flat-stalk, and source-library unramified-stalk ideal assembly proved in Lean

lean.statement:
theorem rootProductChart_stalk_localization {L N : Scheme.{u}} (n : N ⟶ L)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (y : Spec R) (hφ : Etale φ)
    (x : N) (hy : φ y = n x) (f : R) (hf : f ∈ y.asIdeal)
    (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k)
    (α : pullback n φ ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f))))
    (hα : α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R (∀ k : Fin m,
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) =
        pullback.snd n φ) :
    let B := N.presheaf.stalk x
    let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (L.presheaf.stalk (n x))).map (n.stalkMap x).hom
    ∃ (k : Fin m) (R₀ : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsLocalRing R₀) (f₀ : R₀),
      f₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀ ∧
      let p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R₀) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f₀
      let D := AdjoinRoot p
      ∃ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
        letI : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
        let E := Localization.AtPrime P
        ∃ β : B →+* E, IsLocalHom β ∧ β.Flat ∧
          J.map β = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀).map
            ((algebraMap D E).comp (AdjoinRoot.of p))
